prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production sprite animation atlas for the approved Russian bronze mace warrior, faithfully matching both references. Image 1 is approved design, image 2 approved idle atlas for exact per-cell body scale. Transparent RGBA 1536x1024, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows of 512x512 cells, six chronological ATTACK frames read left to right then next row. No grid or labels.

Strict nadir orthographic camera looking vertically straight DOWN at crown and top surfaces, ZERO camera tilt. Warrior generally faces bottom of image. Camera and character scale fixed. Central bronze helmet dome diameter90-100px; helmet center near local256,240 in each cell. Keep ample padding inside each cell. Same round domed bronze riveted helmet, cream fur collar, bronze pauldrons, red leather sleeves, brown boots, wooden shield in left hand on screenright. Right hand on screenleft holds same wooden haft and spherical lobed bronze mace as reference; NEVER an axe, sword, hammer or club. Strong outlined stylized hand-painted game art, broad clean forms, no photographic texture.

Attack action must use WHOLE BODY shoulder and hip rotation with anatomically natural elbows, not isolated arm waving. Frame0: neutral ready identical idle silhouette, mace down screenleft. Frame1: shoulders and hips rotate 25degrees clockwise as seen above; right mace hand retracts, elbow bends naturally out to left; mace head travels to upperleft behind right shoulder. Frame2: deeper40degree coil, planted boots, mace head at upperleft, natural bend elbow, opposite shoulder and shield counterbalance. Frame3: unwind with hips driving shoulders into FORCEFUL forward downward strike toward screenbottom, right arm extends ahead of warrior; mace head below body with continuous wooden shaft, shield held screenright. Frame4: followthrough shoulders rotate 20degrees opposite coil, mace passes lowercenter slightly right, hips and boots planted. Frame5: recover close to original idle pose so loop can join. Helmet shape remains circular overhead even when body rotates. Show helmet top, shoulder tops, tiny boot tips; hide face and torso front below the helmet. No motion lines, impact effects, extra weapons, detached limbs, backward elbows, raised perspective, or size changes. Background entirely transparent alpha0, no colored haze or glow, only crisp antialiasing along silhouette edges.
notes: Whole-body windup, strict overhead orthographic camera, lobed bronze mace. Registration handled separately.
